title: finance-budget-1on1-prep-priya-2026-q1
content:
Context and purpose:
- 1:1 with Ethan (Finance Director) on 2026 Q1 budget/run-rate and near-term procurement approvals. Goal: align on approvals threshold, confirm runway implications, and set next steps for infra commitments.

Current high-level run-rate snapshot (as of 2026-02-20):
- Monthly operating run-rate: $4.2M/month (~$50.4M annualized) — includes current headcount, committed cloud spend, and Dedicated capacity reservations.
- YTD spend (Jan+Feb pro-rated): $8.1M vs plan $7.6M (+6.6% variance). Main drivers: hiring cadence (net +12 FTEs vs plan), Dedicated pilot capacity overage, and higher-than-forecast MLOps tooling invoices.

Key discussion topics / agenda (30 min suggested):
1) Quick run-rate review (5 min)
   - Call out the +6.6% variance and top 3 drivers.
2) Procurement approvals (10 min)
   - GPU procurement for Dedicated expansion: $2.4M CAPEX (purchase or committed lease). Need decision whether to commit this quarter or defer to Q2. Impact: reduces cash runway by ~6 weeks if paid upfront.
   - SOC2 + external audit vendor contract renewal: $120k annual. Recommend approve (security/compliance-critical).
   - Multi-region network peering and private link (vendor: NetConnect): $60k one-time + $5k/mo. Approve operationally to support Private deployments in EU region.
3) Cost mitigation proposals (8 min)
   - Delay non-critical hires by 4–6 weeks (saves ~ $160k/month).
   - Aggressive autoscaling + batching recommendation from serving-runtime to reduce token spend — need engineering confirmation on impact (target 12–18% savings).
4) Approvals workflow and thresholds (5 min)
   - Reconfirm delegation thresholds: any single procurement > $250k requires exec sign-off; > $1M requires CFO + CEO. Decide if GPU purchase needs special routing.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize runway neutrality options: if we defer GPU purchase, propose temporary Dedicated burst capacity (reserved + burst) to meet near-term SLAs.
- Highlight compliance risk for SOC2 renewal — not optional for Private customers.
- For NetConnect ask: validate contractual liability and data residency clauses before sign-off.
- Show month-by-month cash burn scenario for both commit vs defer (have slides from Conway deck, slide 6–8).

Data to bring (have linked artifacts ready):
- Detailed run-rate model (Confluence link above) — bring sensitivity table (+10%, -10% spend).
- Procurement requests: PROC-4821 (GPU), PROC-4799 (SOC2 vendor renewal), PROC-4835 (NetConnect).
- Engineering estimate for autoscaling savings (Lena/KPIs).
- Current headcount plan vs hiring pipeline (sheet: Hiring-plan-2026).

Decisions needed from Ethan in meeting:
- Approve SOC2 vendor renewal ($120k) — recommended YES.
- Direction on GPU procurement: approve full commit now ($2.4M) OR approve phased commit (pay partial deposit) OR defer to Q2.
- Approve NetConnect one-time + OPEX (recommended YES if contract terms acceptable).

Follow-ups / action items (owner / target date):
- Priya: run two commit scenarios (full GPU purchase vs phased vs defer) and update cash runway slides — due 2026-02-28.
- Ethan: confirm approval thresholds to apply for GPU (exec vs CFO) and loop in CEO if needed — due 2026-03-01.
- Lena (engineering): provide technical delta and estimated token-cost savings from autoscaling/batching (quantified %) — due 2026-02-27.
- Marco (procurement): get final contract redlines from NetConnect and SOC2 vendor (confirm data residency & liability) — due 2026-02-28.
- Finance ops: pre-prepare payment plan options for GPU vendor (lease vs capex) and tax/capex impact notes — due 2026-03-02.

Open questions / risks to flag:
- If GPU purchase is approved and paid upfront, need to re-run monthly cash buffer to ensure runway >= 9 months.
- Autoscaling savings are estimated — need engineering validation before including in forecast.
- Potential timing mismatch between contract start and when capacity is needed (risk of paying for unused capacity).

Quick checklist before the 1:1:
- [ ] Update run-rate slide (Priya)
- [ ] Attach PROC tickets to Confluence page
- [ ] Pull latest cloud invoices for Jan/Feb
- [ ] Confirm Lena availability for follow-up deep-dive

Post-meeting follow-up (template to send after 1:1):
- Short summary of decisions made, list of action items with owners + due dates, link to updated Confluence run-rate model and procurement tickets.

Notes to self (informal scratch):
- Keep tone collaborative. If Ethan pushes to defer GPU, suggest hybrid option (smaller initial commit + option to scale).
- If exec sign-off required, prepare a 1-pager for CEO with runway impact and risk trade-offs.

End.
